source_evidence: Companies subject to the proxy rules will typically provide detailed compensation disclosure, including a compensation discussion and analysis section, in their annual proxy statement.
question: Misconception: “Executive compensation details are always in a company’s 10-K, so I don’t need to look at its proxy statement.” Is this correct?
answer: Not necessarily. Companies subject to proxy rules typically provide detailed compensation disclosure in the annual proxy statement, usually on Form DEF 14A. If the disclosure is not in the proxy statement or the company has not filed one, the Form 10-K should include it. A Form 8-K may also disclose certain changes to executive compensation under Item 5.02.
